{{Quote|Take a look through my ''Smuggler's Handbook''&mdash;a collection of background tidbits to help out fellow smugglers. I've covered several topics which can help liven up your illegal enterprises and get you out of trouble.|Platt Okeefe|<ref name="Platt's Smugglers Guide">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Smuggler's Handbook''''' or '''''Platt's Smuggler Handbook''''' was a book written by the legendary [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]]. It was designed to help provide a general overview of the smuggling business for new smugglers. It covered different kinds of employers, different ways to acquire a ship, supply locations and a number of contacts to help out.

==Behind the scenes==
The "Smuggler's Handbook" is the [[in-universe]] name for ''Platt's Smugglers Guide''.
